entries.title: sellmonitor.com

positions.frontendSenior: Building new and growing existing analytics and automation tools that bring marketplace sellers to the service.

frontendSenior.text: Launched 6 new sections of the service.
items: Order geography — a region and warehouse map on ECharts.
Query monitoring — product positions for selected search queries.
Positions in shelves — product distribution across recommendation shelves.
Niche analysis — a niche table with filters and drill-down into products.
Suggestions — a public idea board on Next.js and Strapi: moderation, comments, and text pre-moderation via OpenAI.
Promo banners — targeting, display frequency, and content through Strapi.

frontendSenior: Developed 5 more existing sections: Repricer, Sales, Unit economics, Ad management, and Support tickets.
Rebuilt the public sellmonitor.com website: home page, pricing, marketplace pages, partner program, and SEO pages.
Developed the shared component library on TanStack Table and ECharts.
productDesign: Designed the interfaces of 6 new sections of the service: page structure, tables, filters, charts, and user flows — without mockups, directly on the frontend.
Designed improvements to 5 existing sections during development.
Evolved the visual language of the shared component library: tables, charts, loading and empty states.

positions.frontendLead: Organizing the frontend team's work and developing the studio's client projects.

frontendLead: Led a frontend team of 5 developers: task prioritization, code review, releases, and stack decisions.
Established a shared code style across the team's projects: ESLint, Prettier, lint-staged, and commitlint.

frontendLead.text: Worked on 8 studio projects across different stacks.
items: CMS and corporate website for an agricultural holding — Next.js.
Marketplace of ghost-produced music tracks — Nuxt.
Coconut water brand website — Laravel and Vite.
Promo landing for a charity fund — Laravel and Blade.
Hot sauce brand landing — Next.js.
Mango snack brand landing — Next.js.
Widgets for an airport parking service.

frontendLead.text: Key project — the CMS and corporate website for an agricultural holding.
items: Migrated the CMS from Next.js 14 Pages Router to Next.js 15 App Router and from Redux to Zustand.

Completed and launched the CMS — 18 sections: pages, menus, products and brands, production sites, press center, banners, partners, vacancies, a WYSIWYG editor with images. Designed the interface without mockups on a component library.

Built the website from scratch on Tailwind CSS and Motion — 16 pages from mockups: a component base, animated sections, a brand and product catalog, a press center, an interactive map, and feedback forms with attachments.

frontendLead: Wrote unit tests for components and business logic with Jest.

entries.dismissal: Project completion. Work on the CMS and the website for the agricultural holding was finished.
